perms.agents: Agents (MCP) get exactly the same access as the app · they can't bypass these rules. The "who read what" log lives in "Advanced".
perms.bg.title: Background activity
perms.fda.title: Full Disk Access
perms.how.1: 1 · Press "Grant access" — "System Settings · Privacy & Security · Full Disk Access" opens.
perms.how.2: 2 · Flip the switch next to BMem (if it's missing, add it with "+" and pick BMem.app).
perms.how.3: 3 · Relaunch the app · status refreshes via "Check again".
perms.why.bg.1b: index in the background and survive reboots (launch at login).
perms.why.bg.2b: a resident daemon. Turn it off · indexing only while you search.
perms.why.bg.3b: we don't touch the network at all.
perms.why.fda.1b: read the chosen folders outside the app sandbox.
perms.why.fda.2b: read-only. BMem never writes or deletes in indexed folders.
perms.why.fda.3b: only your home folder is visible, the rest reads as "empty", not an error.
